data.one_liner: Provides a ValueListenable‑like API for async operations, exposing an AsyncSnapshot.
data.what_it_does: It defines AsyncListenable, an interface that delivers AsyncSnapshot updates for Futures or Streams. AsyncNotifier implements this interface and lets you set or replace async sources, while AsyncListenableBuilder rebuilds widgets based on snapshot changes.
use_when: You need to observe async results outside the widget tree
You want a ValueListenable‑style API for Futures/Streams
You need to rebuild UI when async state (data, error, loading) changes
avoid_when: A simple FutureBuilder or StreamBuilder is sufficient
You require full state‑management solutions like Bloc or Riverpod
strengths: Handles both Future and Stream uniformly
Provides snapshot (data, error, loading) out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to async snapshot handling, no broader state‑management features
No code generation or advanced tooling

alternatives.name: async
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general async utilities and Stream helpers, though without the ValueListenable‑style snapshot API
